request.message: Okay, let's build a new flow. We're going to take SRT from Grass Valley. That SRT will go into Uplynk's ingest, where we'll do add detection using scte, and then that'll then flow through to the Uplynk transcoders. From the transcoders, we will take an output to the live events platform, so that'll be path A, and then path B will be to a channel as well. And the channel will be used for 24-7 distribution to OTT and YouTube, and then the live event will be occasional use using that same source feed.
Thanks, that looks great. Let's add an OTT output on live event.
This would be an independent OTT output from the live event. It would not be connected to the 24-7 linear channel.

annotations.text: Okay, we'll have the slicer ID, which would be srt1, and then we'll have some slicer configuration options. We'll need to enable preview, probably allow multiple concurrent previews of three max.

This event will occur every Saturday from 3 o'clock to 5.30 EST.

It's a football tournament. Name the event Red Sox.
